edition.witness_note: Lake 1912 Loeb copy-text; Lightfoot/Funk middle recension not yet locked as second witness

source_text: [1] Ἀπέχεσθε τῶν κακῶν βοτανῶν, ἅστινας οὐ γεωργεῖ Ἰησοῦς Χριστός, διὰ τὸ μὴ εἶναι αὐτοὺς φυτείαν πατρός: οὐχ ὅτι παῤ ὑμῖν μερισμὸν εὗρον, ἀλλ’ ὰποδιῡλισμόν. [2] ὅσοι γὰρ θεοῦ εἰσιν καὶ Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ, οὗτοι μετὰ τοῦ ἐπισκόπου εἰσίν. καὶ ὅσοι ἂν μετανοήσαντες ἔλθωσιν ἐπὶ τὴν ἑνότητα τῆς ἐκκλησίας, καὶ οὗτοι θεοῦ ἔσονται, ἵνα ὦσιν κατὰ Ἰησοῦν Χριστὸν ζῶντες. [3] μὴ πλανᾶσθε, ἀδελφοί μου: εἴ τις σχίζοντι ἀκολουθεῖ. βασιλείαν θεοῦ οὐ κληρονομεῖ: εἴ τις ἐν ἀλλοτρίᾳ γνώμῃ περιπατεῖ, οὗτος τῷ πάθει οὐ συγκατατίθεται.
pass_a_gloss: Keep away from the evil weeds, which Jesus Christ does not cultivate, because they are not the Father's planting. Not that I found division among you, but rather a filtering out. For as many as belong to God and to Jesus Christ, these are with the bishop. And as many as repent and come into the unity of the church, these too will belong to God, so that they may be living according to Jesus Christ. Do not be deceived, my brothers: if anyone follows a schismatic, he does not inherit the kingdom of God. If anyone walks by an alien opinion, he does not agree with the passion.
pass_b_english: Stay clear of the bad weeds. Jesus Christ does not tend them, for they are not the Father's planting (Matthew 15:13). Not that I found division among you; I found a sifting.
All who are God's and Jesus Christ's are with the bishop. And all who repent and enter the unity of the church will be God's too, so that they may live according to Jesus Christ.

Do not be deceived, my brothers: if anyone follows a man who splits the church, he does not inherit the kingdom of God (1 Corinthians 6:9–10). If anyone walks in an alien mind, he does not consent to the Passion.

choices.why: A filtering out; the impure were strained off, which is why no division was found.

choices.english: a man who splits the church
choices.why: Participle of σχίζω; 'schismatic' is accurate but stiff in reading text.

choices.english: does not consent to the Passion
choices.why: Against those who deny Christ's real suffering; 'consent' keeps the verb's sense of assent.

anf_compare.notes: Minor. ANF 'exceeding purity' interprets ἀποδιϋλισμόν; the word means a filtering or straining out. Rest same sense.

bible_refs.note: φυτεία ἣν οὐκ ἐφύτευσεν ὁ πατήρ μου, the Father's planting

notes: Source shows 'ὰποδιῡλισμόν' with odd diacritics (for ἀποδιϋλισμόν) and 'παῤ' for παρ’; reproduced as supplied.
αὐτούς is masculine though βοτανῶν is feminine: the weeds are people.

review.notes: Paragraph [1] checked clause by clause. Ἀπέχεσθε τῶν κακῶν βοτανῶν, ἅστινας οὐ γεωργεῖ Ἰησοῦς Χριστός, διὰ τὸ μὴ εἶναι αὐτοὺς φυτείαν πατρός is A 'Keep away from the evil weeds, which Jesus Christ does not cultivate, because they are not the Father's planting' and B 'Stay clear of the bad weeds. Jesus Christ does not tend them, for they are not the Father's planting (Matthew 15:13)'. οὐχ ὅτι παῤ ὑμῖν μερισμὸν εὗρον, ἀλλ’ ὰποδιῡλισμόν is A 'Not that I found division among you, but rather a filtering out' and B 'Not that I found division among you; I found a sifting' (εὗρον understood). ὅσοι γὰρ θεοῦ εἰσιν καὶ Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ, οὗτοι μετὰ τοῦ ἐπισκόπου εἰσίν and ὅσοι ἂν μετανοήσαντες ἔλθωσιν ἐπὶ τὴν ἑνότητα τῆς ἐκκλησίας, καὶ οὗτοι θεοῦ ἔσονται, ἵνα ὦσιν κατὰ Ἰησοῦν Χριστὸν ζῶντες keep bishop, repentance, future belonging, and purpose in both. μὴ πλανᾶσθε, ἀδελφοί μου: εἴ τις σχίζοντι ἀκολουθεῖ. βασιλείαν θεοῦ οὐ κληρονομεῖ and οὗτος τῷ πάθει οὐ συγκατατίθεται keep both negations; B's (1 Corinthians 6:9–10) sits on the kingdom clause named in the supplied bible_refs. Title 'The Father's Planting' names the thought; odd diacritics on ὰποδιῡλισμόν are disclosed.

Source paragraph 1 fully covered. Greek identity confirmed: Ignatius, Philadelphians 3 via Lake 1912 Loeb. Pass A renders all clauses: evil weeds not cultivated by Christ (φυτείαν πατρός), not division but filtering (ἀποδιϋλισμόν), belonging to God/Christ with bishop, repentant return to unity, living per Christ, warning against deceit, schismatic followers not inheriting kingdom (βασιλείαν θεοῦ οὐ κληρονομεῖ), alien opinion not assenting to Passion (τῷ πάθει οὐ συγκατατίθεται). Pass B matches: 'bad weeds... not the Father's planting (Matthew 15:13)', 'I found a sifting' (for ἀποδιϋλισμόν), 'All who are God's and Jesus Christ's are with the bishop', 'repent and enter unity... live according to Jesus Christ', 'Do not be deceived... follows a man who splits... does not inherit kingdom (1 Cor 6:9–10)', 'walks in alien mind... does not consent to the Passion'. All checks pass: source identity, completeness, negation (οὐχ, οὐ, οὐκ, οὗτος... οὐ), agency (Christ does not cultivate, one follows, one walks), modality (will be, may live), doctrine (schism excludes from kingdom, unity with bishop), scripture citations (Matt 15:13 for φυτεία; 1 Cor 6:9–10 for βασιλείαν... κληρονομεῖ) correctly added per apparatus. Title 'The Father's Planting' names the thought (φυτείαν πατρός). Notes explain OCR: 'ὰποδιῡλισμόν' for ἀποδιϋλισμόν, 'παῤ' for παρ’, and αὐτούς masculine despite βοτανῶν feminine (weeds as people). No uncertainties.
